tools.name: mathpix_get_usage
tools.description: API usage counts for this Mathpix account over a date range, grouped by usage type (image, image-async, pdf ...), request arguments or app id and aggregated by a timespan. Use it to reconcile billing and watch consumption. Free to call. GET /v3/ocr-usage.

tools.name: mathpix_list_image_results
tools.description: Search and list stored results of earlier image/strokes OCR requests (/v3/text etc.), newest first: the recognized text, confidence, detected content types and the request options. Requests made with improve_mathpix=false are not stored. Free to call. GET /v3/ocr-results.

tools.name: mathpix_list_documents
tools.description: List documents previously submitted for async processing (/v3/pdf), newest first: pdf_id, input file or URL, status (received, loaded, split, completed, error), page counts and timestamps. Use the pdf_id with the get/output tools. Free to call. GET /v3/pdf-results.

tools.name: mathpix_get_document_status
tools.description: Processing status of a submitted document: status (received, loaded, split, completed, error), pages done, and the status of each requested conversion. Poll this until status is completed before reading the output (percent_done reaches 100 before the output files exist). Free to call. GET /v3/pdf/{p

tools.name: mathpix_get_conversion_status
tools.description: Status of the output-format conversions of a document (the pdf_id) or of a Markdown conversion (the conversion_id): one entry per requested format with status processing, completed or error. Free to call. GET /v3/converter/{id}.

tools.name: mathpix_get_document_output
tools.description: Read the TEXT result of a processed document: mmd (Mathpix Markdown, the primary output), md (plain Markdown), html, latex (single .tex) or lines.json (line-by-line data with geometry). Long outputs come back in slices (offset / next_offset). Binary formats (docx, pdf, zip, images) cannot be fetched

tools.name: mathpix_get_conversion_output
tools.description: Read the TEXT result of a Markdown conversion started with mathpix_convert_markdown: md, html or latex. Long outputs come back in slices (offset / next_offset). Binary formats cannot be fetched through this server. Free to call. GET /v3/converter/{conversion_id}.{ext}.

tools.name: mathpix_ocr_image
tools.description: BILLED BY MATHPIX (pay as you go, per image; see mathpix.com/pricing/api): recognize math, text, tables and chemistry in ONE image and return Mathpix Markdown (LaTeX math inside \( \) / \[ \]), and optionally HTML, styled LaTeX or structured data. The image must be a public URL (or a small data URI)

tools.name: mathpix_submit_document
tools.description: BILLED BY MATHPIX (pay as you go, per page processed; see mathpix.com/pricing/api): start async conversion of a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB or similar document at a PUBLIC URL into Mathpix Markdown. Returns a pdf_id immediately; poll mathpix_get_document_status until completed, then read it with mathpix_g

tools.name: mathpix_convert_markdown
tools.description: Convert Mathpix Markdown (MMD) text into plain Markdown, HTML or LaTeX. Returns a conversion_id; read the result with mathpix_get_conversion_output (check mathpix_get_conversion_status first). Conversions may be billed by Mathpix under your plan; see mathpix.com/pricing/api. Each call creates a new

tools.name: mathpix_delete_document
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a processed document's output at Mathpix (Markdown, JSON lines, images, all converted formats) and the uploaded source copy. Cannot be undone; read what you need first. Only billing metadata is kept. DELETE /v3/pdf/{pdf_id}.

tools.name: mathpix_delete_conversion
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete the output files of a Markdown conversion at Mathpix. Cannot be undone; read what you need first. DELETE /v3/converter/{conversion_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mathpix_list_documents, mathpix_get_document_output, mathpix_get_conversion_output, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_convert_markdown · Private data: mathpix_list_documents, mathpix_get_document_status, mathpix_get_conversion_status, mathpix_get_document_output, mathpix_ocr_image, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_delete_document, mathpix_delete_conversion · Public sink: mathpix_ocr_image, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_convert_markdown · Destructive: mathpix_get_conversion_status, mathpix_delete_document, mathpix_delete_conversion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mathpix_list_documents, mathpix_get_document_output, mathpix_get_conversion_output, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_convert_markdown · Private data: mathpix_list_documents, mathpix_get_document_status, mathpix_get_conversion_status, mathpix_get_document_output, mathpix_ocr_image, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_delete_document, mathpix_delete_conversion · Public sink: mathpix_ocr_image, mathpix_submit_document, mathpix_convert_markdown · Destructive: mathpix_get_conversion_status, mathpix_delete_document, mathpix_delete_conversion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
